entries.clue: Himalayan cedar whose name is Sanskrit for timber of the gods
Foundation register of the English organ, its name Greek for through all
Hickory of the Mississippi valley whose kernels fill a Thanksgiving pie
Ten minutes off, mug in hand, defended by the shop steward
Row of pipes, one to each key; a compound register draws several
Astringent compound that turns an over-stewed pot bitter
South American tree whose violet-blue blossom turns Pretoria purple every spring
Toothed blade drawn to and fro to cut through a log or a board
Composer of the Fifth Organ Symphony, whose finale is a wedding standard
Round button under a keyboard, pressed by the thumb to change registration
Served long and cold in the American South, where it comes over-sweetened
Of a flue pipe: unplugged at the top, an octave above a plugged one of the same length
Matching pot and six of everything, brought out when the vicar calls
